description: Window log large enough for a dictionary plus the source, capped at the maximum window log
notes: zstd 1.5.6, ZSTD_dictAndWindowLog (lib/compress/zstd_compress.c), for a 64-bit target (ZSTD_WINDOWLOG_MAX = 31), with ZSTD_highbit32 written as 31 - __builtin_clz. The asserts are dropped as in release builds. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: three branches on d, the window size and the 2^31 cap, a 64-bit shift, a ctlz and a phi: 17 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
